narrative.overview: A precise personal ledger designed to fit in one hand. Financial hierarchy is immediate and every summary remains traceable.

rules.name: Semantic Direction
rules.body: Mint and coral always communicate money direction or state.

rules.name: Number First
rules.body: Financial figures receive weight before scale.

rules.name: Flat Ledger
rules.body: If every section casts a shadow, hierarchy has failed.

dos: Do keep all essential phone actions at least 44 by 44 pixels.
Do pair category color with an icon and text label.
donts: Don't squeeze desktop tabs into a phone viewport.
Don't use decorative glass or gradient text.
